get.summary: Get an access log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.access-logs.read.

post.summary: List access logs page by page: every operation call of the caller’s side with its result, duration and client; filter by time range, trace, user, session, operation, result and status code. Requires auditing.access-logs.read.
Issue a captcha (4 digits, valid for one use within 5 minutes).

Sign in with user name and password (tenant optional; platform accounts leave it empty; when the captcha is on, include the id and code from auth.captcha). Returns a second-step ticket when the account has two-factor on, otherwise access and refresh tokens.

get.summary: Sign-in page settings: available sign-in methods, third-party providers and whether a captcha is required.

post.summary: Revoke the session of the current token.

get.summary: Return the current user, tenant, session and roles.
Return the current principal's effective permissions, roles, menu tree and page codes.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for new tokens; the refresh token rotates and the old one stops working.
Switch the current session to another tenant (home tenant or a tenant the user is a member of) or back to the platform (platform accounts only); returns new tokens.
Second step of two-factor sign-in: submit the code with the ticket from auth.login; returns access and refresh tokens on success.

get.summary: Get a condition hit of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.condition-hits.read.

post.summary: List condition hits page by page: access policy and permission condition hits of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.condition-hits.read.

delete.summary: Delete configuration entries on the caller’s side in bulk; built-in entries are rejected one by one. Requires settings.configs.delete.

post.summary: Create a configuration entry on the caller’s side: the key is unique per side and the value is checked against the data type; a tenant entry with a platform key overrides it (rejected when the platform entry forbids overrides). Requires settings.configs.create.

get.summary: Get a configuration entry (encrypted values are never returned). Requires settings.configs.read.

put.summary: Update a configuration entry on the caller’s side: name, group, value, default, data type, encryption, order, description and status (the key cannot change; an encrypted entry keeps its value when none is given). Requires settings.configs.update.

post.summary: List configuration entries page by page: platform principals see platform entries, tenant principals see platform entries plus their own; encrypted values are never returned. Requires settings.configs.read.

delete.summary: Delete delegation records; an active one stops taking effect. Requires access.delegations.delete.

post.summary: Create a delegation: the delegator hands one permission or one role to the delegatee for a limited time, and must hold it now. Requires access.delegations.create.
Revoke a pending or active delegation, keeping the record. Requires access.delegations.revoke.
List the delegations of the current side with paging; their status follows from revocation and the validity window. Requires access.delegations.read.

delete.summary: Delete departments in batch; departments that still have children or members are rejected item by item. Requires organization.departments.delete.

post.summary: Create a department anywhere in the tree (code unique within the tenant; parent must exist; leader must be a user of this tenant). Tenant side only; requires organization.departments.create.

get.summary: Get a department with its ancestors, leader user name, child count and member count. Requires organization.departments.read.

put.summary: Update a department's name, leader, order, description and status (the parent is changed with departments.move). Requires organization.departments.update.

post.summary: Move a department under another parent or to the top level; moving under itself or a descendant is rejected. Requires organization.departments.update.

get.summary: The whole department tree of the current tenant with direct member counts. Requires organization.departments.read.

delete.summary: Delete dictionary items in bulk; items that still have children are rejected one by one. Requires settings.dict-items.delete.

get.summary: List all items of a dictionary (depth-first, with depth). Requires settings.dict-items.read.

post.summary: Create an item in an enabled dictionary on the caller’s side: the code is unique in the dictionary, the parent must be in the same dictionary, making it the default clears the other default. Requires settings.dict-items.create.

get.summary: Get a dictionary item. Requires settings.dict-items.read.

put.summary: Update a dictionary item: parent, name, value, description, metadata, default, order and status (the code cannot change; an item cannot move under itself or its descendants). Requires settings.dict-items.update.

delete.summary: Delete dictionaries on the caller’s side in bulk; built-in dictionaries and those that still have items are rejected one by one. Requires settings.dicts.delete.

post.summary: Create a dictionary on the caller’s side; codes are unique across platform and tenants (dictionaries are never overridden). Requires settings.dicts.create.

get.summary: Get a dictionary. Requires settings.dicts.read.

put.summary: Update a dictionary on the caller’s side: name, category, description, order and status (the code cannot change). Requires settings.dicts.update.

post.summary: List dictionaries page by page: platform dictionaries plus the caller’s tenant dictionaries. Requires settings.dicts.read.

get.summary: Get the options of a dictionary by code: tree dictionaries are flattened depth-first, disabled items are flagged, a disabled dictionary has no options. Any signed-in user.
Get a data change log of the caller’s side with field-level before and after values. Requires auditing.diff-logs.read.

post.summary: List data change logs page by page: entity inserts, updates and deletes of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.diff-logs.read.

delete.summary: Delete editions and their whitelists in batch; editions still used by tenants are rejected item by item. Requires tenancy.editions.delete.

get.summary: List every edition (by order, then code) with its whitelist size and the number of tenants on it. Platform side only; requires tenancy.editions.read.

post.summary: Create an edition with an initial whitelist (tenant-side permissions only); it can become the default edition for new tenants. Requires tenancy.editions.create.

get.summary: Get an edition with its permission whitelist. Requires tenancy.editions.read.

put.summary: Update an edition's name, description, default flag and order; the code cannot change. Requires tenancy.editions.update.

post.summary: Replace an edition's permission whitelist; the effective permissions of tenants on it narrow or widen immediately. Requires tenancy.editions.update.

get.summary: Get an exception log of the caller’s side, including the full stack trace. Requires auditing.exception-logs.read.

post.summary: List exception logs page by page: unhandled exceptions of the caller’s side with type, message and location. Requires auditing.exception-logs.read.

delete.summary: Delete field security rules. Requires access.field-security.delete.

post.summary: Create a field security rule: how a role, user or department reads a field and whether it may change it. Requires access.field-security.create.

get.summary: Get a field security rule. Requires access.field-security.read.

put.summary: Edit a field security rule, including enabling and disabling it. Requires access.field-security.update.

get.summary: List the entities and fields that field security can protect (registered by each package). Requires access.field-security.read.

post.summary: List the field security rules of the current side with paging. Requires access.field-security.read.

get.summary: List up to 20 active users that can be impersonated in a tenant (or the platform), matched by keyword. Requires identity.impersonation.start.

post.summary: Sign in as another user: opens a separate session for the target and returns tokens carrying the actor claim. Tenant subjects stay in their own tenant. Requires identity.impersonation.start.
End impersonation: revokes the impersonation session and returns tokens for the actor's original session.

get.summary: Get a sign-in log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.login-logs.read.

post.summary: List sign-in logs page by page: sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation and password change events of the caller’s side, successful or not. Requires auditing.login-logs.read.

delete.summary: Remove users from departments in batch; when a primary membership is removed the next one becomes primary. Requires organization.memberships.delete.

post.summary: Add a user of this tenant to a department, optionally with a position; the first membership of a user becomes the primary one. Requires organization.memberships.create.

put.summary: Update a membership's position, primary flag, employee number, grade, hire date and order. Requires organization.memberships.update.

post.summary: List memberships filtered by department, user, position or primary flag, with user, department and position names. Requires organization.memberships.read.

delete.summary: Delete operator nodes in batch; page nodes and directories that still have children are rejected item by item. Requires access.menus.delete.

get.summary: List the whole menu tree (hidden nodes, operator-created directories and links, and the customization flag of page nodes). Platform side only; requires access.menus.read.

post.summary: Create an operator node: a directory (top level only) or an external link (http / https, may sit in a directory); page nodes come from page registrations and cannot be created. Requires access.menus.create.

get.summary: Get one menu node. Requires access.menus.read.

put.summary: Update a menu node: page nodes only change presentation (title, icon, order, directory, visibility, caching, pinned tab) and become customized; operator nodes may also change their link and permission. Requires access.menus.update.

post.summary: Restore a page node's presentation to its registration and clear the customization flag. Requires access.menus.update.

delete.summary: Delete numbering rules on the caller’s side in bulk; rules that have issued numbers are rejected one by one. Requires settings.numbering-rules.delete.

post.summary: Create a numbering rule on the caller’s side: the date format must distinguish the reset cycle and the time zone is an IANA id. Requires settings.numbering-rules.create.

get.summary: Get a numbering rule, including its current period and last issued sequence value. Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.

put.summary: Update a numbering rule on the caller’s side; once it has issued numbers the format is frozen and only name, description, order, status and tenant sharing can change. Requires settings.numbering-rules.update.

post.summary: List a rule’s issue records page by page (a tenant only sees the ones it requested). Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.

Safely reset the sequence: the next value must exceed the highest value already issued in the current period (jumping forward is allowed), a reason is required and platform rules need the rule code typed back as confirmation. Requires settings.numbering-rules.reset.

Issue numbers from a rule: committed in its own transaction, numbers are consumed permanently; the same idempotency key replays with identical parameters and conflicts otherwise. Requires settings.numbering-rules.generate.
List numbering rules page by page: platform principals see platform rules, tenant principals see their own rules plus platform rules shared with tenants. Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.

get.summary: Preview numbers for a given format (pure computation, nothing is issued, up to 50). Requires settings.numbering-rules.read.
Get an open API log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.open-api-logs.read.

post.summary: List open API logs page by page: signed open API calls of the caller’s side with their signature checks. Requires auditing.open-api-logs.read.

get.summary: Get an operation log of the caller’s side, including its details. Requires auditing.operation-logs.read.

post.summary: List operation logs page by page: audited business operations of the caller’s side with their results and durations. Requires auditing.operation-logs.read.

get.summary: Get a permission change log of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.permission-change-logs.read.

post.summary: List permission change logs page by page: grants, revocations, role membership, data scope and edition changes of the caller’s side. Requires auditing.permission-change-logs.read.

get.summary: List the grantable permission catalog: the caller's side by default; platform principals may pass side=tenant for the tenant side (used to edit edition whitelists); for tenant principals the catalog is narrowed by their edition. Requires access.permissions.read.

delete.summary: Delete positions in batch; positions still referenced by memberships are rejected item by item. Requires organization.positions.delete.

post.summary: Create a position (code unique within the tenant). Requires organization.positions.create.

get.summary: Get a position. Requires organization.positions.read.

put.summary: Update a position's name, order, description and status. Requires organization.positions.update.

post.summary: List positions with paging, keyword, filters and sorting. Requires organization.positions.read.

get.summary: Your profile and account security summary (two-factor, last password change). Any signed-in user.

post.summary: Change your own password; requires the current password and revokes your other sessions.
Turn off a two-factor method: confirm with a current authenticator code. Not available while impersonating.
Turn on a two-factor method: confirm the authenticator with a code from the newly generated key. Not available while impersonating.
Start binding an authenticator: generate a new key (confirm with an authenticator code within 10 minutes). Not available while impersonating.

delete.summary: Delete roles in batch together with their members and permissions; built-in roles cannot be deleted. Requires access.roles.delete.

post.summary: Create a role on the current side (platform or tenant); the code is unique per side and cannot be changed. Requires access.roles.create.

get.summary: Get a role with its granted permissions and member count. Requires access.roles.read.

put.summary: Update a role's name, description, order and status. Requires access.roles.update.

post.summary: Assign users to a role; users must belong to the role's side. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
Deny permissions on a role: revokes the same grants and writes Deny rules (optional validity window and reason); a role deny only removes that role's own grants. Requires access.roles.grant.
Grant permissions to a role; codes must exist in the catalog and match the role's side. Requires access.roles.grant.

get.summary: Get the inheritance of a role: all its parents, all its children, and the grants and denials it inherits. Requires access.roles.read.
List the members of a role. Requires access.roles.read.

post.summary: Revoke permissions from a role. Requires access.roles.grant.

Set the direct parents of a role to the given set (empty removes all inheritance): its holders get the parents' grants right away, and the parents' denials apply to it too. Requires access.roles.set-parents.
Remove users from a role. Takes effect at the user's next token refresh. Requires access.roles.assign.
Change the validity window of a member assignment; expired or future assignments are dropped from decisions at once. Requires access.roles.assign.

get.summary: List the roles a user holds on the current side (platform or tenant). Requires access.roles.read.

post.summary: List roles of the current side with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires access.roles.read.

delete.summary: Remove tenant members in batch; they can no longer switch into the tenant. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.delete.

get.summary: List a tenant's members (users whose home tenant is elsewhere and who enter it by membership) with user name and display name. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.read.

post.summary: Add a user as a tenant member; rejected when the user is already a member or the tenant is the user's home. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenant-members.create.

delete.summary: Delete tenants in batch and remove them from the directory; tenants that still have users are rejected item by item. Requires tenancy.tenants.delete.

post.summary: Provision a tenant: write the tenant and register it (enabled) in the tenant directory; the administrator is created with tenants.initialize-admin. Platform side only; requires tenancy.tenants.create. Without an edition the default edition applies (an error if there is none).

get.summary: Get a tenant with its administrator's user name and user count. Requires tenancy.tenants.read.

put.summary: Update a tenant's name, description, expiry and order; the name is mirrored to the directory. Requires tenancy.tenants.update.

post.summary: Move a tenant to another edition, or lift edition limits; its users' effective permissions follow the new whitelist immediately. Requires tenancy.tenants.update.
Create the first administrator of a tenant with every tenant-side permission; the password must be changed at first sign-in. Once per tenant. Requires tenancy.tenants.initialize-admin.
List tenants with paging, filters, keyword and sorting. Requires tenancy.tenants.read.

get.summary: Tenants the current user can enter (home tenant and memberships, active only) and whether the platform is available; the control center switches with auth.switch-tenant.

post.summary: Resume suspended tenants in batch. Requires tenancy.tenants.suspend.
Suspend tenants in batch: the directory marks them disabled, their users cannot sign in and calls carrying the tenant are rejected. Requires tenancy.tenants.suspend.

get.summary: Aggregate the logs of the caller’s side by trace, user, session or client address into one timeline, oldest first, with counts per log type. Requires auditing.traces.read.
Read a user's data scope override (tenant side only); without one the roles decide. Requires access.user-data-scopes.read.

post.summary: Set or clear a user's data scope override (tenant side only); the override replaces the roles' scopes entirely. Requires access.user-data-scopes.update.

get.summary: List the permissions granted or denied directly to a user on the current side, with windows and reasons. Requires access.user-grants.read.

post.summary: Deny permissions directly on a user; a user deny overrides every grant. Requires access.user-grants.grant.
Grant permissions directly to a user (optional validity window and reason). Requires access.user-grants.grant.
Revoke direct grants or denies of a user. Requires access.user-grants.grant.

get.summary: Read one of your own settings by scene and key; the value is empty until saved. Any signed-in user.

put.summary: Write one of your own settings by scene and key, replacing it whole or creating it; an empty value clears it. Any signed-in user.

delete.summary: Delete users in batch (soft delete) and revoke their sessions; you cannot delete yourself. Requires identity.users.delete.

post.summary: Create a user: a tenant principal creates one in its own tenant; a platform principal may name the home tenant or create a platform account. Requires identity.users.create.

get.summary: Get a user by ID; tenant principals only see their own tenant. Requires identity.users.read.

put.summary: Update a user's display name, email and phone number. Requires identity.users.update.

post.summary: Set a new password for a user, revoke their sessions and require a change at next login. Requires identity.users.reset-password.
List users with paging, filters, keyword and sorting; tenant principals only see their own tenant. Requires identity.users.read.
Lock users in batch and revoke their sessions; you cannot lock yourself. Requires identity.users.lock.
Reset two-factor for users in bulk (clears all methods and authenticator keys); you cannot reset yourself. Requires identity.users.reset-two-factor.
Unlock users in batch. Requires identity.users.lock.

access.delegations.create.description: Let a user hand one of their permissions or roles to another user for a limited time.

access.delegations.delete.description: Delete delegation records; an active one stops taking effect.

access.delegations.read.description: View time-limited delegations of permissions and roles between users.

access.delegations.revoke.description: End a pending or active delegation before it expires.

access.field-security.create.description: Create rules that mask or lock fields for roles, users or departments.

access.field-security.read.description: View field security rules and the entities and fields they can protect.

access.field-security.update.description: Edit, enable and disable field security rules.

access.menus.create.description: Create directories and external links in the menu.

access.menus.read.description: View the whole menu tree, including hidden and operator-created nodes.

access.menus.update.description: Change how menu nodes are presented and restore page defaults.

access.permissions.read.description: View the permission catalog of the current side.

access.roles.assign.description: Assign users to roles and remove them.

access.roles.create.description: Create roles on the current side (platform or tenant).

access.roles.delete.description: Delete roles together with their members and permissions.

access.roles.grant.description: Grant permissions to roles and revoke them.

access.roles.read.description: View roles, their members and their permissions.

access.roles.set-parents.description: Make roles inherit the permissions of other roles on the same side, and remove that inheritance.

access.roles.update.description: Edit role names, descriptions, order and status.

access.user-data-scopes.update.description: Override a user's data scope in place of their roles' scopes, or clear the override.

access.user-grants.grant.description: Grant, deny and revoke permissions directly on users, with optional validity windows.

access.user-grants.read.description: View the permissions granted or denied directly to users.

auditing.access-logs.read.description: View every operation call of the caller's side with its result, duration and client.

auditing.condition-hits.read.description: View access policy and permission condition hits of the caller's side.

auditing.diff-logs.read.description: View entity inserts, updates and deletes of the caller's side with field-level before and after values.

auditing.exception-logs.read.description: View unhandled exceptions of the caller's side, including stack traces.

auditing.login-logs.read.description: View sign-in, refresh, sign-out, tenant switch, impersonation and password change events of the caller's side.

auditing.open-api-logs.read.description: View signed open API calls of the caller's side with their signature checks.

auditing.operation-logs.read.description: View audited business operations of the caller's side with their results.

auditing.permission-change-logs.read.description: View grants, revocations, role membership, data scope and edition changes of the caller's side.

auditing.traces.read.description: Aggregate the logs of the caller's side by trace, user, session or client address into one timeline.

identity.impersonation.start.description: Sign in as another user of the current tenant (platform: any tenant) to troubleshoot on their behalf.

identity.users.create.description: Create users in the current tenant.

identity.users.delete.description: Delete users of the current tenant.

identity.users.lock.description: Lock and unlock users of the current tenant.

identity.users.read.description: View users of the current tenant.

identity.users.reset-password.description: Reset user passwords; the user must change the password at next sign-in.

identity.users.reset-two-factor.description: Clear a user's two-factor methods and authenticator key so they can sign in with the password and enroll again.

identity.users.update.description: Edit user profiles of the current tenant.

organization.departments.create.description: Create departments anywhere in the tree.

organization.departments.delete.description: Delete departments that have no children and no members.

organization.departments.read.description: View the department tree and department details.

organization.memberships.read.description: View which users belong to which departments.

organization.memberships.update.description: Change a membership's position, primary flag, employee number, grade and hire date.

organization.positions.delete.description: Delete positions that no membership references.

settings.configs.create.description: Create configuration entries on the caller's side, including tenant overrides of platform entries.

settings.configs.delete.description: Delete configuration entries on the caller's side that are not built in.

settings.configs.read.description: View platform configuration entries and the caller's own; encrypted values are never shown.

settings.configs.update.description: Edit, encrypt and disable configuration entries on the caller's side.

settings.dict-items.create.description: Add items to enabled dictionaries on the caller's side.

settings.dict-items.delete.description: Delete dictionary items without children on the caller's side.

settings.dict-items.read.description: View the items of visible dictionaries.

settings.dict-items.update.description: Edit, move and disable dictionary items on the caller's side.

settings.dicts.create.description: Create dictionaries on the caller's side.

settings.dicts.delete.description: Delete empty dictionaries on the caller's side that are not built in.

settings.dicts.read.description: View platform dictionaries and the caller's own.

settings.dicts.update.description: Edit and disable dictionaries on the caller's side.

settings.numbering-rules.create.description: Create numbering rules on the caller's side.

settings.numbering-rules.delete.description: Delete numbering rules on the caller's side that never issued a number.

settings.numbering-rules.generate.description: Issue numbers from the caller's rules or from platform rules shared with tenants.

settings.numbering-rules.read.description: View numbering rules, preview formats and read issue records.

settings.numbering-rules.reset.description: Move a rule's sequence forward past every value issued in the current period.

settings.numbering-rules.update.description: Edit numbering rules on the caller's side; the format freezes after the first issue.

tenancy.editions.create.description: Create editions with an initial permission whitelist.

tenancy.editions.delete.description: Delete editions that no tenant uses.

tenancy.editions.read.description: View editions and their permission whitelists.

tenancy.editions.update.description: Edit editions and replace their permission whitelists; tenants on them follow immediately.

tenancy.tenant-members.create.description: Let a user whose home tenant is elsewhere enter a tenant.

tenancy.tenant-members.delete.description: Revoke a member's access to a tenant.

tenancy.tenant-members.read.description: View which users may enter a tenant as members.

tenancy.tenants.create.description: Provision a tenant and register it in the tenant directory.

tenancy.tenants.delete.description: Delete tenants without users and remove them from the directory.

tenancy.tenants.initialize-admin.description: Create the first administrator of a tenant with every tenant-side permission.

tenancy.tenants.suspend.description: Suspend and resume tenants; suspended tenants cannot sign in.

tenancy.tenants.update.description: Edit tenant names, descriptions, expiry and order.
